experiment.pipeline: repository offline YOLOE semantic masks + offline VGGT Depthmap and Camera Branch
experiment.dimension_method: largest semantic component; per-frame robust tabletop; horizontal PCA P2-P98 footprint; object-specific top height percentile; robust temporal fusion

scale_calibration.method: unclipped elongated semantic component; median 3D endpoints from 2% mask tails; temporal 3.5-MAD rejection

limitations: No independent ground-truth dimensions were provided, so these are estimates rather than absolute-error measurements.
Transparent ruler and transparent bottle regions can produce incomplete or biased monocular depth.
The bottle is reported as major footprint × minor footprint × height; it is not assumed perfectly cylindrical.
Frame IQR captures reconstruction and segmentation repeatability, not total systematic calibration uncertainty.
